title: [3.0-beta6] Eros: Message bolus stopped not cleared
symptom: When a bolus is stopped (either before or after injection starts), an overlay message 'Bolus interrupted or stopped' remains on the screen and cannot be closed. The only way to clear it is to switch to another app and back, which rebuilds the screen.
fix: The issue was reportedly fixed by a commit referenced by MilosKozak: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/bbcbf3f90535c719fb70bbcb41c486cc7bf475ad
